posts.title: Computers all the way down
posts.description: Think of 'computer' in the broad sense: a system that stores information, follows rules, and transforms inputs into outputs. By that definition, the universe certainly computes . Physical laws update the state of matter from one moment to the next. posts.title: music in the air
posts.description: Headphones are great - I wear them almost every day, but there's something special when I get to turn on my speakers. Music filling the air and filling your body is special. Even if the bass isn't blasting I have the feeling that there are near imperceivable sensations in my body that changes the experience in a meaningful way. Here's to filling the air with music .
